name: Disable Field Button
description: Adds a Disable button to field configuration forms on entity display pages.
project_description: The Disable Field Button module adds a Disable button to each field's configuration form on the Manage display and Manage form display pages. In Drupal core, disabling a field on an entity display requires dragging its row to the Disabled section at the bottom of the page. This module adds a one-click alternative: expand a field's settings, click Disable, and the field is immediately removed from the active display and the display entity is saved. It works on both view displays and form displays, for all entity types and bundles, requires no configuration, and provides no permissions or config of its own — it relies entirely on the access already required to reach the Field UI display forms.
